results.description:
When three daring and powerful businessmen unite to create the ultimate indulgence at Sexy & Sinful: Spa & Resort, the heat is turned up in ways they never imagined. Derrick, Bryant, and Mitch never expected that hiring a curvy, captivating woman for the general manager position would spark such intense desires.

Jenny Taylor is drowning in debt and facing bankruptcy, forcing her to take on a second job at the luxurious resort. With her experience at Club Desire, she's no stranger to catering to the wealthy and demanding, but nothing could prepare her for the seductive allure of her three new bosses. One unforgettable Valentine’s night of passion isn't enough for Derrick, Bryant, and Mitch. Their chemistry with Jenny is off the charts, leaving them craving more than just a fling.

This contemporary romance weaves a tantalizing tale of polyamory and reverse harem dynamics, delivering steamy, sexy, and seductive scenes that will leave you breathless. Fans of popular reverse harem novels like Mia's Men by Lucy Felthouse, Den of Vipers by K.A. Knight, and Power of Five by Alex Lidell will find their next book obsession in this standalone novella, guaranteed to provide a happily-ever-after with high levels of heat wrapped around plenty of sass and wit.

Dive into this deliciously sinful story today and immerse yourself in the ecstasy at Sexy & Sinful: Spa & Resort!
